llm_fetch_required.hint: Craft Health 'Latest News' page is a chronological press/achievements timeline organised by year and month headers (e.g. '2021', then 'January 2021'). Dates come from the month/year section headings, not per-item. Resolve relative links against https://www.crafthealth.me/.
